create_WSPollerConfig: create a WSPollerConfig with app_id, ip, port, and api_version fields for websocket polling
connect_WSPollerNode: connect a WSPollerNode to a websocket server using the configured ip and port
start_streaming_WSPollerNode: start streaming data from a websocket connection by sending a start stream message
recv_WSPollerNode: receive the next message from the websocket connection synchronously or asynchronously
ws_publisher_WSPollerNode: run the ws_publisher async generator to continuously poll and yield WSMessage objects from websocket
